features.name: Frenzy
features.desc: While raging, when you use Reckless Attack, the first target you hit on your turn takes extra damage: a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus (+2 → 2d6, +3 → 3d6, +4 → 4d6).

grants.note: +{rageBonus}d6 damage to the first target each turn (when using Reckless Attack while raging)

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.desc: Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while you are raging.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you frighten creatures within 30 feet (Wisdom saving throw).

features.name: Retaliation
features.desc: As a Reaction, you attack a creature within 5 feet of you that dealt damage to you.
